text:
Carlos: Quick sync 2 need a short playbook for stacking private-offer discounts + HW credits for SI-led renewals next quarter. Goal: one-pager teams can use when building marketplace private offers and partner-backed bundles.

Anya: +1. We keep getting asks from SDRs asking whether to put credits into the PO or keep them as separate SI rebates. Need a clear recommendation. :thinking_face:

Leah: From HW partner side, we prefer a single package (bundle) so joint announcement looks clean. But partners want a minimum committed spend to trigger HW credits. Typical is 612 month commit.

Mike: Marketplace constraints: private offers must specify SKUs and pricing up front. If we want flexible HW kicker tiers, we should map them to explicit SKU combos, otherwise procurement flags it.

Carlos: Proposed structure (draft):
- Base private offer: 10% off hosted API list for committed 12mo spend >= $100k
- SI bundle add-on SKU: $X credit applied at redemption (ship as marketplace SKU)
- HW credit: partner issues co-funded credit when commit >= $250k, expires 90 days post-deal

Anya: Love that. Can we add a renewal accelerator? e.g., 3% additional discount if renewed 3050 days early. Helps reduce churn.

Leah: Works, provided SI/partner credit stacking is capped. Partners don't want unlimited stacking. Suggest cap: total vendor+partner discounts <= 35% and HW credit max $50k per deal.

Mike: If we encode the cap in SKU metadata it simplifies billing. Example codeblock for SKU mapping:```
PRIV-OFFER-12M-100K -> 10% off
SI-ADD-10K -> $10,000 SI credit (redeemable)
HW-KICKER-50K -> $50,000 HW credit (co-funded)
```

Carlos: Good. Also need playbook rules for announcements:
- Joint public announcement only if partner approves and deal value >= $500k
- SI co-marketing ok for all deals > $100k with partner logo usage pre-approved
- For HW bundles, delay public announcement until HW shipment milestone (to avoid premature marketing claims)

Anya: Ops ask: how do we track redemption windows and cap usage? We need a single source of truth. Suggest we use marketplace private-offer metadata + a simple spreadsheet for partner accounting during pilot.

Leah: Partners will want monthly reconciliation. They expect line items showing committed vs redeemed credits. We should include a reconciliation cadence in the playbook.

PartnerBot: Link to vendor-private-offer-template: https://redwood.internal/docs/partner/private-offer-template (internal).

Mike: One more constraint  some cloud marketplaces disallow multi-vendor combo SKUs. If that happens, fallback: issue vendor credit as a post-sale rebate and document in the private-offer notes.

Carlos: Action items:
- Anya: draft one-pager with discount ladder + renewal accelerator by EOD Thu
- Leah: confirm partner max credit caps and preferred reconciliation format by Fri
- Mike: map SKU naming conventions and fallback notes for marketplaces by Mon
- Carlos: draft announcement gating rules and a short checklist for solutions teams by Mon

Anya: I'll include a sample one-line legal blurb for the PO: "Offer subject to partner co-funding and redemption terms; credits applied per SKU and expire 90 days after deal registration."

Leah: I'll loop in hardware partner ops and share their reconciliation template (CSV) once I have it.

Mike: I'll add a short section in docs about marketplace SKU limitations and include sample JSON metadata we embed in the private-offer notes. Example: `{"max_total_discount_pct":35,"hw_credit_cap_usd":50000}`

Carlos: Perfect. If no objections, we'll pilot this with two SI-led prospects next month and iterate. cc @Leah @Anya :thumbsup:

Leah: :thumbsup:

Anya: Sounds good. I'll post the one-pager in #partnerships when ready.

PartnerBot: Automated reminder set: follow-up check-in scheduled 7 days before pilot start.
